# Poles and Depth

## Overview

Poling is only possible where a pole finds bottom. Past that the crew rows or drifts.

## Mechanics

Roll once per leg. On a failure the pole finds nothing and the leg costs double.

## Design Philosophy

The marsh should get harder the further in the crew goes without a roll telling anybody
they are in danger.

## Related Rules

- [[Lantern Oil]]

## Notes

Introduced before Session 3 and used twice since.
